intake.matter_summary: Rideshare driver injured in an intersection collision seeks to recover from the at-fault left-turning driver; torn meniscus with surgery, lost income, totaled vehicle, and an exhausted PIP layer. Contingency representation toward a civil jury trial.

conflicts_check.notes: No prior or current representation adverse to Sofia Reyes; the firm has never represented Bradley Hutchins or his liability insurer. No relationship to the independent eyewitness.

time_entries.narrative: Initial intake interview with client; preliminary assessment of liability and injuries.
Run conflicts check; open matter; prepare contingency engagement letter.
Review Florida crash report and emergency/operative medical records; build chronology of the collision and treatment.
Interview independent eyewitness Gerald Fontaine; obtain signed statement.
Obtain and review PIP correspondence; analyze no-fault threshold and coverage-exhaustion issues.
Draft and file negligence complaint in the Circuit Court for Sunhaven County.
Client counseling regarding comparative-fault exposure and settlement posture.
Prepare and send settlement demand to the liability insurer; assemble damages documentation.
Draft written discovery: interrogatories and requests for production to the defendant.
Prepare for depositions of the two drivers and the independent eyewitness.
Trial preparation: exhibit organization, intersection diagram, and witness planning.
